scope: Changes authored since 12:30: temporary monitor recovery, live cleanup preview, cold-idle capture startup, and user-facing information messages. Existing unrelated dirty changes are excluded.
root_cause: In the exact 6.3.4 upstream netlink parser, multiple virtual interfaces on one wiphy overwrite a single entry. A native DOWN managed interface arriving after the selected monitor replaces its ifindex. No native interface or user AP configuration is deleted for this fix.

rounds.focus: Failure/success support evidence versus fixed upstream source
findings: Failed scene contains hcxmon0/hcxmon1 AND native wlan0/wlan1; successful scene contains only the two monitors.
Original parser reproduces selected index replacement; corrected parser preserves selected monitor for either ordering.

rounds.focus: Cleanup identity, concurrency, ownership, cancellation and deployment
findings: Read-only preview uses the management queue without replacing the capture task state.
Asynchronous dialog open releases completed worker ownership; active capture remains view-only.
Same-device reconnect during preview invalidates the review. Force bypasses occupancy only, never identity/type/owner checks.
Deployment validates hashes, preserves previous cache on corruption, and avoids cleanup on a changed connection.

rounds.focus: Architecture/runtime artifacts, background parity and information/export UI
findings: Big-endian byte-swap macro side-effect bug reproduced in upstream and corrected using single-evaluation builtins.
Five static ELF variants cover all ten declared package architectures; ARM EABI soft-float and MIPS32r2 soft-float checked.
Background compatibility selection requires kernel >=5.15 and original 6.3.4; newer or older native tools retain their path.
Linux release resource inventory and licenses include all compatibility artifacts.
Information panel hides background history audit, simplifies known progress/result text and internal diagnostic file references; raw export entries remain unchanged.

tests.final_broad: 82 tests: 80 passed, 2 environment skips; one missing compatibility-fixture contract found earlier was corrected and rerun.
tests.runtime: 10 passed, including real local POSIX publish/cache/cancel/connection failure and background version/kernel selection.
tests.information: 12 passed, including raw log export and dependency/login log separation.
tests.debian: Actual original/fixed C parser and byte-swap regressions executed; all ELF headers/ABI inspected; actual x86_64 -h and --version executed without capture.
tests.visual: Actual Qt light/dark InfoPanel captures reviewed after loading production resources/fonts. No layout/theme change.
tests.syntax: 22 Python modules compiled; UTF-8 checked; shell syntax checked.

boundaries: No live router was modified or capture attempted in this review. TL-XDR6088 cold-idle acceptance remains pending.
The separate exec_request channel-closed event in the earlier log is not proven to share the enumeration cause; do not claim it fixed by the parser correction.
Legacy firmware/native-tool execution remains unchanged; this source correction applies to hcxdumptool 6.3.4 only.
Non-x86 binaries were statically inspected, not executed on their target routers.
Full Debian desktop GUI acceptance remains pending; this pass runs native non-GUI/source and artifact checks.
Optional textual BPF compilation is omitted in the separate component; existing precompiled BPF input is retained and verified.
line_endings: Preserved indexed LF where Windows writeback would otherwise expand the whole-file diff; no source content change.
